intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder-37 (MRT37) is caused by homozygous mutation in the ANK3 gene.

checks.claim: Autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder-37 (MRT37) is caused by homozygous mutation in the ANK3 gene.

paragraphs.text: Autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder-37 (MRT37) is a neurodevelopmental disorder. Affected individuals have moderate intellectual disability, an attention deficit-hyperactivity disorder (ADHD)-like phenotype, and behavioral problems (Iqbal et al., 2013).

paragraphs.text: In affected members of a consanguineous family with MRT37, Iqbal et al. (2013) identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the ANK3 gene. The mutation affected the longest isoform of the gene. Iqbal et al. (2013) stated that this was the first reported familial mutation in ANK3. A Drosophila knockdown model showed memory defects, which supported the causal role of the ANK3 mutations and the gene's role in cognitive function.
